families.license: original arrangement and synthesis made for this project; the underlying melody, Korobeiniki, is a public-domain Russian folk song

modifications.note: 1980s-synth arrangement of Korobeiniki (A minor, 120 BPM): a 4-bar intro (8 s) and a 40-bar body (80 s) whose tails are folded onto its own first bar; the game loops the body through the stream loop offset named in packs/default/pack.json. Synthesized by tools/make_coldwar_bgm.py with numpy/scipy and encoded with ffmpeg libvorbis q6 (44.1 kHz stereo); byte sha256 bound in assets/assets-measurements.json; replaced the maki ligon arrangement on 2026-10-10 (owner decision), whose file and license record were moved out of the project
